sentences.text: Mickael Gordon `` Mick '' Thomson -LRB- born November 3 , 1973 -RRB- is an American heavy metal musician .	heavy metal	Heavy metal music
Born in Des Moines , Iowa , he is best known as one of two guitarists in Slipknot , in which he is designated # 7 .	Slipknot	Slipknot (band)

Thomson originally met founding Slipknot members Anders Colsefni , Donnie Steele and Paul Gray through their mutual involvement in death metal band Body Pit , and later replaced Craig Jones in the group in 1996 .
